name: Effie
source:
Effie works as a barmaid at the Raven’s Roost and is a well-known “woman of the night”.

Famously ditzy & airheaded, she has an effortless charm and loves to laugh.

There are rumors, however, that Effie’s a different woman around those close to her.

She takes it upon herself to teach Fiona how to handle daily mortal life. Her methods are certainly... encouraging.
